title: what friends are for
author: MeasurelessCaverns
fandoms: Avatar: The Last Airbender (Live Action TV 2024)
summary:
Zuko reached up, fingers catching the loose strand just before it could touch the chutney on the bao. He tucked it behind her ear with casualness. His hand lingered for a millisecond too long along her jawline, where Mai knew she hadn’t imagined his thumb swiping the edge of her mouth.
Crumb. She told herself quickly. The warmth of the bao still clung to her mouth, and now his scent was wrapped up in it, too.
She moved back a little, reasserting distance. Her expression stayed neutral. The bite was good. The chutney was sweet and tart. The pork was well-spiced. Perfect balance. She hated that she could barely enjoy any of it in the frenzied state of her mind.
It wasn’t lost on him how purposefully she avoided his gaze this entire time.

summary:
“The spirits have spoken. They cannot answer your simple question, for they have a greater message for you to hear.” It had been some time since Wu spoke these words. Whether the prophecy could finally be fulfilled by this boy, she could not say, but it was clear the spirits wanted him to hear it. They would not allow him to hear of anything else. “When the heir of dragons is reborn, the tides of war will turn.”
  He jolted in surprise, then leaned forward with an eager grin. The fire danced in the reflection of his eyes. “Really? The spirits said that? Exactly that?”
  “Indeed, they did. Does it hold meaning to you?”
  “I think so.”
  The prophecy’s hum finally went quiet.
It's been two years since Zuko was banished and he is unrecognizable from the lonely boy who confidently declared his intent to bring the Avatar home in chains. His new goal of ushering in a new age of airbending should be impossible, but the friendships and connections he has made in his travels very well might make it possible.

She once believed Aang could save the world, but now, she must save him.

summary:
In a time when the gods walked among mortals, the elements were imbued with divine essence. Bending was not mere skill—it was a sacred gift, bestowed in exchange for devotion and sacrifice. The majestic lion turtles, divine creations of these ancient deities, once roamed the lands as guardians of balance and wisdom.
Now, the gods have grown silent as the world burns under the Fire Nation’s war. The Avatar, a living bridge between mortal and divine, stands as the last hope for balance. Amidst this chaos, Katara and Sokka—children of Poseidon—bear a legacy of both blessing and burden. summary: The war is over, but the fire within the royal palace still burns, now fueled by a different kind of heat. Zuko, scarred but finally at peace, poised to inherit the throne and restore honor to the Fire Nation. Azula, stripped of her power, her sanity fractured, confined to a gilded cage where her once-brilliant flames have dwindled to embers. They are siblings, bound by blood and a shared history of pain. He, the banished son, she, the fallen prodigy.“Azula, our relationship is so messed up. It’s been like that as long as I can remember. And maybe it’ll be like that for the rest of our lives. But one fact never changes. No matter what, you’re still my sister.”It’s a game, of course. A dangerous one. I’ll play along. I’ll let him get close. I’ll let him see the cracks in my armor.Let him think he’s saving me.He is weak, I am strong.It’s repulsive. It’s forbidden. It’s… everything.He should despise me! I AM madness!But his touch, his presence… it’s a fire I thought had died. And in this cold, empty world, I crave the heat, even if it burns me alive.Especially, if it burns me alive.

summary: Zuko and Katara are married, symbolically uniting their nations while they grow up and wait to truly be married. In between, everything that set the stage for peace and alliances falls apart. What are they to each other in the wake of another war?--The Fire Nation is ruthless in it's colonization of the world, but the Crown Prince Iroh seems to be one last hope for peace with other nations. As he takes more control of international politics from his aging father, Fire Lord Azulon, he makes more peace treaties and slows down the war effort. Chief Hakoda, working to establish more autonomy and control of his people's fate (as they struggle on the precipice of colonization or extinction), travels North to once again unite the sister tribes. But he gets more than he bargained for... His daughter, who had been sent North for her own protection years before, is chosen to be the sacrificial lamb in their peace treaty. She will marry the son of the younger prince, never to see the throne but always to live at court. Her marriage will solidify a union between North and South, Water and Fire.Until Ozai decides he's had enough of his brother's peaceful ways and stages a coup.

Blinking open her eyes, she mused that death was truly strange.
She had never dedicated time to thinking about death–it was a useless endeavor. Now, though, she let herself muse. Her life had been arduous but–and she loathes to admit it–it had gotten better. She had gotten better. It was hard for her to believe, even now after her life had quietly come to an end, but it had happened.

Her next breath stuttered.
That wasn’t right. She had passed on to the Spirit World; she wasn’t supposed to feel warm.

Where do we start?”Her husband wore a similar smirk. “We start with Yue.”ORAfter they learn about Mirabel’s bedroom situation in Julieta’s condo, Arnook and Helena create a proper bedroom for Mirabel.

title: Loving you
author: SunnyKawaii24
tags: Other Additional Tags to Be Added
summary: High school student, Katara, has secretly admired her now partner for Bending class, Zuko, from afar for years, her heart aching with the hope of something more. Pushed by her bold and unrelenting friend Toph, she finally decides to take a leap and get to know him, unaware that Zuko harbors feelings for her too but is torn by his own family drama. With a controlling father, Ozai, who relentlessly pits him against his sly sister, Azula, Zuko wonders if bringing Katara into his chaotic life is the right thing to do. But when Katara goes to great lengths to achieve her intentions with Zuko, will she succeed, or will it backfire on her?And what will happen when simple arguments between benders take a turn into full-blown showdowns, where emotions fuel their abilities and the very elements around them become weapons?As emotions collide and secrets unravel, Katara and Zuko must walk the delicate line between love and the different things threatening to pull them apart. Or where katara and zuko have a crush on each other but doesn't know, Ozai has Zuko traumatized, Azula enjoys following his steps; and all the teen drama becomes next level when there are benders involved.
